story_title: Register with Email or Phone Number
acceptance_criteria: Do not allow duplicate email addresses or phone numbers; validate formats; hash passwords; create the account successfully when the input is valid.

story_title: Verify Account via OTP or Email
acceptance_criteria: OTP must expire; resend attempts must be limited; accounts cannot be activated with an incorrect or expired OTP.
Valid credentials return an access token and refresh token; invalid credentials show an appropriate error message; locked accounts cannot log in.
A valid refresh token creates a new access token; expired or revoked tokens must be rejected.
An OTP or reset link is available; the new password must satisfy password rules; old login sessions are revoked.

story_title: Manage Role-Based Access for Camper, Host, Porter, and Admin
acceptance_criteria: APIs enforce authorization on the backend; users cannot access features outside their role; unauthorized actions return 403.

story_title: Update Personal Profile and Emergency Contact
acceptance_criteria: Valid profile information is updated successfully; emergency contacts are saved; access to sensitive data is permission-checked.

story_title: Log Out from Current Device or All Devices
acceptance_criteria: The current token is revoked; the log out from all devices option invalidates every refresh token.
Only the Host or Porter for the related trip can view the information; the user can edit or revoke sharing permission.
Search, view, lock, and unlock accounts; do not hard-delete related data.

story_title: Write Audit Log for Important Actions
acceptance_criteria: Save actor, action, target, time, before data, and after data.
Filter by user, action, time, and target; logs cannot be edited.
Show reporter, target_type, target_id, reason, and status; Admin can move Pending to Reviewing, Actioned, or Rejected; every change is audit logged.
